claim: NTMoFA in West District is open Tue-Fri 09:00-17:00 and Sat-Sun 09:00-18:00 with free admission.
NTMoFA, established 1988, is Taiwan's first and only national-grade fine arts museum and one of Asia's largest at 102,000 sq m including an outdoor sculpture park.
quote: established in 1988 as the first and only national-grade fine arts museum in Taiwan ... covers 102,000 square meters, including the Public Outdoor Sculpture park, making it one of the largest museums in Asia

claim: The National Museum of Natural Science is open Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00, closed Mondays, with main halls being the Life Science, Human Cultures and Global Environment Halls.
quote: open Tuesday to Sunday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and is closed on Mondays ... Life Science Hall, Human Cultures Hall, and Global Environment Hall

claim: For its 40th anniversary, the NMNS galleries are free every Friday 14:00-17:00 throughout 2026 (excluding special exhibitions, theaters, science center and gardens).
quote: admission to the Galleries ... is free every Friday from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM from January 1, 2026, to December 31, 2026. This does not include ticketed special exhibitions and theaters, the science center, botanical garden

claim: Baojue (Paochueh) Temple's landmark is a roughly 30-metre tall golden statue of Milofo / Maitreya, the Laughing Buddha, popular for photos.
quote: famous for its 101-feet (30 metre) tall statue of Milofo, known as the Laughing Buddha, with the official Indian name being Maitreya Bodhisatva

claim: Baojue Temple is about a 15-minute bus or 10-minute taxi ride from Taichung Station and reachable by YouBike; a smaller Maitreya statue is said to bring fortune if you touch its ears or navel.
quote: about a 15-minute bus ride or a 10-minute taxi ride from Taichung Station ... a smaller Maitreya statue said to bring good fortune if you touch its ears or navel

claim: Taichung Confucian Temple in North District, built 1972-1976 in Song-dynasty palace style after Qufu's temple, is always free to the public.
quote: constructed in Song dynasty architectural style following the layout of Qufu Confucian Temple in Shandong ... always open to the public for free

claim: The Confucius Temple, a rare example of Song-dynasty palace architecture in Taiwan, features the Lingxing Gate, a crescent pond and the double-eaved Dacheng Hall.
quote: rare example of Song Dynasty palace-style architecture in Taiwan ... the main hall, the Dacheng Hall, which features a double-eaved hip roof

claim: The 2026 Dajia Mazu Pilgrimage from Dajia Jenn Lann Temple departs the night of April 17, 2026, running 9 days and 8 nights.
quote: officially scheduled to begin at 10:05 PM on April 17, 2026, and continues for 9 days and 8 nights, returning on April 26

claim: Dajia Jenn Lann Temple, built 1730, anchors one of the world's largest religious festivals and houses a Golden Mazu statue made of over 270 kg of pure gold in its basement cultural museum.
quote: built in 1730, was named one of the three largest religious festivals in the world by the Discovery Channel ... Golden Mazu statue ... made of over 270 kilograms of pure gold

claim: The Wufeng Lin Family Mansion and Garden in Wufeng District is the residence of one of Taiwan's Five Major Families; its Gong-Bao-Di is the only remaining Qing-era first-class official residence in Taiwan.
quote: The Wufeng Lin family is one of Taiwan's Five Major Families. Gong-Bao-Di is the only remaining Qing-era first class official residence in Taiwan

claim: Wufeng Lin Family Mansion admission is NT$250 full / NT$200 concession / NT$125 child, with ticket sales 09:00-12:00 and 13:00-16:00 and closing at 17:00; a free English video guide is available on passport deposit.
quote: Full ticket NT$250 ... concession ticket NT$200 ... school children ticket NT$125 ... Tickets can be purchased seven days a week between 9am and 12pm, and from 1pm to 4pm, with the property closing its doors at 5pm

claim: Zhongshe Flower Market (Chung-she Flower Garden) in Houli has over six hectares of flowers blooming year-round, open daily 09:00-18:00.
quote: over six hectares of flowers blooming in all four seasons ... open daily from 9 AM to 6 PM

claim: Zhongshe Flower Market admission is about NT$150 in peak tulip season (Jan-Mar) and NT$120 in low season (Apr-Dec), with winter the most popular time for tulips, lilies and lavender.
quote: NT$120 (April to December) and NT$150 (January to March) during tulip season ... Winter (January to March) is the most popular time to visit

claim: Gaomei Wetlands in Qingshui District is a free-admission ecological reserve famed for its sunset, a long wooden boardwalk over the mudflats and a backdrop of wind turbines.
quote: The long wooden boardwalk allows visitors to walk far into the wetlands ... the iconic row of wind turbines spinning slowly in the distance ... generally has free admission

claim: Gaomei boardwalk opening hours vary daily by the tides and should be checked in advance; nearby Wuqi Fishing Harbor (about 10 minutes away) offers seafood markets and restaurants.
quote: Boardwalk opening hours vary daily and usually depend on the tides ... Wuqi Fishing Harbor ... 10-minute drive ... regular market area with food stalls
